card.name: The word including after a category
card.fires_on: The word "including" right after a comma or opening parenthesis that follows a general category noun, such as reactions, treatments or events. It introduces a specific example in warnings and contraindications.

modes.label: After comma
modes.description: "including" follows a comma after a broad category, introducing specific examples.
modes.example: History of serious hypersensitivity reactions,<< including>> anaphylaxis, to pegyl

modes.label: After parenthesis
modes.description: "including" opens a parenthetical list of examples.
modes.example: Employ other supportive measures (<<including>> oxygen and vasopressors) in
